description: Defines a Retrofit API interface for performing cart-related network operations in a Kotlin-based frontend. It includes methods for fetching, updating, removing, and applying coupons to a shopping cart, with detailed comments explaining REST endpoints and assumptions.

classes.name: CartApi
classes.description: Retrofit interface defining network operations for cart management, including fetching, adding, updating, removing items and coupons.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's cart.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the cart by productId.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon code to the current cart.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon from the cart (via DELETE endpoint).

methods.name: removeCouponWithBody
methods.description: Removes a coupon with additional request body if backend requires line items or coupon code in body.
